text:
alyssa: Kicking off Banyan Health onboarding — quick sync. Can we confirm stakeholders and define 30/60/90 success criteria? Suggested owners: Jordan = customer success, Mike = integration, Tara = enablement. Surface any renewal risks now. Proposed kickoff Wed 10am PST.

jordan: +1. I'll own stakeholder mapping. Main goal: production inference at <200ms p95 and < $0.008/token. Success criteria candidates: 1) demo flow deployed to prod, 2) baseline latency/cost established, 3) SSO + data path validated. Thoughts?

mike: From infra side: need model selection + sample payloads. Can Banyan share 1 week of representative logs and current token counts? Also recommend a dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbor risk.

tara: I'll schedule enablement: two sessions — integration lab (devs) and prompt tuning (PMs). Proposed dates: Week1 integration, Week3 tuning. I'll post invites after stakeholder list.

alyssa: Renewal risk note — customer's contract auto-renews in ~11 months but current usage is low. If we don't ramp to target (1k DAU-equivalent) within 90 days, flag as at-risk. Prioritize quick wins: templates + prebuilt evals and one demo flow.

onboardbot: Reminder: kickoff meeting created — 2025-06-12 17:00 UTC. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood/abc123 :spiral_calendar:

jordan: FYI tagging exec sponsor @lena_ops and onboarding lead @drew_product. Lena requested monthly business reviews — add that to success criteria.

mike: Example payload snippet so platform team can pre-config: 
```
{ "user_id": "xyz", "prompt": "summarize: ...", "max_tokens": 512 }
```

tara: Quick risk register item: data residency question from Legal — they want a Private deployment decision by EOW or it may delay rollout. Alyssa can you confirm legal contact?

alyssa: Yup — looping in Sophie from Legal. Final ask: everyone add your top 3 risks + blockers to this thread by EOD Friday so I can build the 30/60/90 playbook. :thumbsup:
